tweaks.description: Turns on ADB on port 5555 over the car's Wi-Fi, and shows the ADB switch in Engineering Mode so it can be turned back on from the screen. Warning: there is no password. Anyone on the car's Wi-Fi can control the head unit. Wireless Android Auto and CarPlay keep working with it on. Turning it off puts everything back; ADB then stops at the next restart.
tweaks.name: ADB over Wi-Fi

needs.reason: Replace the network setup command with one that keeps the ADB address out of the Wi-Fi hotspot's range, so wireless Android Auto and CarPlay still connect
Run the head unit's ADB network setup again, so that works without a restart
Turn on the head unit's own ADB TCP switch, the one in Engineering Mode
Show the ADB switch in Engineering Mode, so ADB can be turned back on from the screen
Put build.prop back as it ships when this is turned off, if the TCP ADB package added lines to it

tweaks.summary: Lets a computer on the car's Wi-Fi control the head unit
